suppress.notes: file name: mockserver-client-java-5.15.0.jar, mockserver-core-5.15.0.jar, mockserver-netty-5.15.0.jar This CVE applies to versions 5.13.0 and older and only when using velocity or javascript templates which interlok-service-tester-wiremock doesn't. Also the mock server is usually ran locally, automatically just a few second for service testing and is not used by users.
file name: swagger-parser-safe-url-resolver-2.1.16.jar This CVE applies to parse-url and not swagger-parser-safe-url-resolver
org.mock-server:mockserver-netty:5.15.0 is the latest release published to Maven Central. Its transitive Prometheus simpleclient artifacts are also at the latest published 0.16.0 line.

file name: spring-boot-loader-2.7.18.jar We are pinned to Spring Boot 2.7.x on Java 17. There is no newer 2.7.x release in Maven Central, so these CVEs cannot be remediated by an in-line version bump at the moment.
Jetty 10.0.26 is the newest Jetty 10 release available in Maven Central. Remediation for this CVE requires moving off the Jetty 10 line, which is outside the current Java 17 / Jetty 10 constraints.

json-patch 1.0 through 1.13 is affected; 1.13 is still the newest published release. No stable same-major patch/minor fix is available: https://repo.maven.apache.org/maven2/com/github/java-json-tools/json-patch/maven-metadata.xml https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-86318 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-86319 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-86512 This is a transitive MockServer dependency. Crafted JSON merge/patch documents can cause stack exhaustion or excessive resource consumption; copy/move operations can also bypass application-level patch access controls. These remain accepted risks, not remediated issues.

jackson-coreutils 2.0 is affected and is still the newest published release. No stable same-major patch/minor fix is available: https://repo.maven.apache.org/maven2/com/github/java-json-tools/jackson-coreutils/maven-metadata.xml https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-86321 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-86511 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-86513 This is a transitive MockServer dependency. Untrusted URLs can cause server-side request forgery, while crafted numbers and JSON pointers can exhaust resources. These remain accepted risks, not remediated issues; restrict mock servers to trusted test inputs.

JAXB RI core 4.0.1 is reported for CVE-2026-92877; upstream confirms incomplete XML factory hardening, including in 4.0.4 and 4.0.9. The fix is merged but the newest published 4.x release is 4.0.9 and does not include it. No stable permitted fix exists. https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-92877 https://github.com/eclipse-ee4j/jaxb-ri/pull/2013 https://repo.maven.apache.org/maven2/com/sun/xml/bind/jaxb-core/maven-metadata.xml This is a transitive MockServer dependency. Unmarshalling untrusted XML on affected JAXP implementations can still expose local files through external entities. This remains an accepted risk, not a remediated vulnerability.
